info.title: IIH Essentials API
info.description:
Description of the REST API of IIH Essentials.
The maximum size limit for a single request (no file) is 16 MB.
The connection timeout is 10 seconds.
Based on Anchor Asset API specification v1.0.
The property $anchor of the schema AggregationValue will be renamed to $pointer in the next version.
In all APIs, 'variableId' is equivalent to the anchor of an attribute

Read timeseries data of multiple attributes.
endpoints.description:
Read timeseries data of multiple attributes.
The method returns a maximum of 2000 values per attribute. If there are more values available in the requested time period the response contains a `hasMoreData` object. This object provides `from` and `to` timestamps to be used to request the remaining values.
If one attribute has reached the limit, the number of values of other attribute could be reduced, too. The reason is that `from` and `to` are adapted to the first and last data point of the attribute which has reached the limit, and `from` and `to` are always applied to all attribute of the request.
The response size is limited to 4 MB.

parameters.name: variableIds
parameters.description: The ids of the attributes to read.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Begin timestamp of the data query. A value stored with a timestamp exactly of `from` is not included in the result.
The special string null can be used to read from the begin of the existing data.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
End timestamp of the data query. A value with a timestamp exactly of `to` is included in the result.
Has to be greater than or equal to `from`.
Special behaviour if `from` and `to` is equal: The value exactly at this timestamp will be read.
The special string null can be used to read to the end of the existing data.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Optional parameter to specify the maximum number of values to be returned for one attribute per request.
Must be between 1 and 2000. If not specified or outside of the boundaries the default limit of 2000 is used.
If there are more datapoints in the requested period than the specified limit, an additional object `hasMoreData` is returned with the response. It provides information how to request the remaining datapoints.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Optional parameter to specify in which time order the values should be returned. If not specified the default value will be Ascending.

parameters.name: interpolated
parameters.description: Optional parameter to return interpolated data.

parameters.name: interpolationInterval
parameters.description: Optional parameter to specify the interpolation interval in milliseconds. If not specified the acquisitionCycle of the Attribute is used.

parameters.name: qualityFilterInclude
parameters.description: Optional parameter to specify whether to include the specified quality groups/codes. True to include them and false to exclude them.

parameters.name: qualityFilterGroups
parameters.description: Optional parameter to specify the quality groups to filter. It's the OR logic with qualityFilterCodes parameter.

parameters.name: qualityFilterCodes
parameters.description: Optional parameter to specify the quality codes to filter. It's the OR logic with qualityFilterGroups parameter.

parameters.name: excludeBadQuality
parameters.description:
Optional parameter to exclude values which have bad quality code.
This parameter was replaced by the new qualityFilter parameters. It is still supported for backward compatibility but it is ignored if at least one of the qualityFilter params is present in the request.
